notes.title: Notice of Participation in the Steam Winter Sale.
notes.notes:
Participate in the annual Winter Sale on Steam.
From December 21, 2023 through January 4, 2024 at 10:00 AM PT, the discount will be 30% off the regular price.
We hope you will take advantage of this opportunity.

notes.title: Decided to participate in Steam VR Festival (2023)
notes.notes:
Steam VR Fest is a celebration of all things virtual reality gaming!
"FANTAVISION202X" will participate in "Steam VR Festival".
This event will run from December 4th at 10am PT to December 11th at 10am PT, and you can purchase it at a 30% discount worldwide during this period.
Please take this opportunity to play "FANTAVISION202X"!

notes.title: Notice of participation in Steam Autumn Sale
notes.notes:
Participate in the annual Autumn Sale on Steam.
The discount will be 30% off the regular price from November 21st 10am PT to November 28th 10am PT.
We hope you will take this opportunity to purchase.

notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 nomination event.
notes.notes:
The Steam Awards is an annual event in which the best game in each category is decided by user votes.
We encourage everyone to vote for "FANTAVISION202X" as "VR Game of the Year"!
Also, don't miss this year's Steam Autumn Sale 2023, which is being held at the same time as our participation, with a special discount of 30% off, so whether you have registered your wish list or are interested in the game, don't miss it.

notes.title: May 10, 2023 Corrected update release notes
notes.notes:
1. MainMenu : "EXIT" → Renamed to "RETURN TO TITLE "
2. Added "CLOSE APPLICATION" menu.
